answer: A decaying identity bond stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 200-unit bond that loses 10 units per epoch unless renewed by verified work. A trader at the wharf dealing in copper and saffron pays once and keeps a slot, while an attacker forging 1,000 identities must post 200,000 units and lose 10,000 units each epoch, with no honest income to restore them. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards; mass forgery bleeds itself dry.
